name: Verity Aegis
description: Hold an aegis of plain fact that no feint or glamour can find a gap in.

name: Verity Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of verity over the ground that carries every disguise away in its flow.

name: Fact Sight
description: Hold the sight on the one fact beneath the show and read every foe by it.

name: Candour Strike
description: Strike with no hidden trick and let the plain force of the blow break a trick-built guard.

name: Absolute Annulment
description: Cancel every false thing the qi field touches and leave only the real standing.

name: Truth Passage
description: Pass through every illusion and false wall by the one true path the field shows.

name: Cause Laid Bare
description: Lay bare the cause behind a foe's strength and strike it past every guard he has raised.

name: Unhidden Sight
description: Make the whole field a place where nothing is hidden and every body shows its true intent.

name: Sovereign Fact
description: State a sovereign fact over a foe and strike so the statement and the blow are one act.

name: Verity Crown
description: Wear a crown of verity that turns false blows and lends every honest stroke more force.

name: Exact Verdict
description: Pass an exact verdict through the guard and into the root of the foe's strength.

name: Truth Cataclysm
description: Drop the whole truth of the field upon it to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier.

name: Made True
description: State one plain fact aloud and the world in sight bends to make it so for a breath with no force that cultivation explains.

name: Divine Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of unveiled fact that stands against every power built on pretence.

name: Real Downpour
description: Rain the unveiled real down upon the ground and break every cover it lands on.

name: Cover Sweep
description: Sweep every cover of qi and cloak from the ground in a single long pass.

name: Real Eye
description: Turn the divine eye on the field and read who is who and what is what at once.

name: Pretence Annulled
description: Annul every pretence the field holds and leave the ground bare to the sight.

name: Real Passage
description: Pass by the one real path through a field of divine glamour and false walls.

name: Divine Reckoning
description: Reckon with a foe through the field and strike his true measure past all guard.

name: Great Eye
description: Make the field one great eye that sees all that is in it as it truly is.

name: Unveiled Decree
description: Speak a decree of the unveiled real over a foe and strike him where it holds him.

name: Real Crown
description: Wear a crown of the real that guards the wearer and swells every stroke made in it.

name: Naked Verdict
description: Deliver a naked verdict through every guard to the centre of the foe.

name: Reality Cataclysm
description: Unveil the real over the whole field to the destructive ceiling of the caster's tier.

name: Undeniable
description: Make a single fact undeniable so that no power and no will in sight can act against it for a breath.

name: Reality Restored
description: Restore the true state of the world in sight to what it was before any falsehood altered it.
